blogs.title: Beyond Text Prompts: The Secret Geometry of Controlling AI Images with Orthogonal Finetuning
blogs.description: This post explains why changing the 'direction' (angle) of neurons in a neural network is more powerful than just changing their 'size' for controlling complex generative tasks like DreamBooth and ControlNet. We break down the concept of hyperspherical energy and how Orthogonal Finetuning preserves the model's ability to generate photorealistic images while allowing users to inject specific constraints like subject identity or edge maps.

blogs.title: The DreamBooth Fast-Fail Problem: Why Your Custom Subject Generation Collapses
blogs.description: Are you tired of training hours only to get muddy, unrealistic images because you set too many training epochs? This article dives into the convergence curves of existing finetuning methods versus the stability of Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT). We explain why OFT acts like a 'safety net' for gradient descent, allowing users to generate custom subjects quickly without the risk of losing their model's high-quality defaults.

blogs.title: Zero Overhead Superpowers: Controlling Diffusion Models Without Slow Inference
blogs.description: Compare OFT against current industry standards like ControlNet and LoRA. This blog explores how Orthogonal Finetuning achieves state-of-the-art control in both subject-driven generation and conditional tasks while introducing zero additional computational cost during inference. We detail how applying a simple matrix transformation at test time makes your generated images as fast as pre-trained Stable Diffusion.
